notes.title: Here it begins
notes.content:
phew! It’s been a wild ride so far, 
last year I started my journey towards what I always wanted to do, making games, so I started. Like any meaningful endeavor, the path never was straight nor was easy. there have been ups and downs. 
a couple of months ago, I finally managed to publish my first ever game on steam ( UNPLUGGED), as a solo game developer. 
now more than ever I believe in what I am doing and what I am looking to get done.
recently, I’ve been busy implementing features and tweaks that some of you have asked for (and more). and I am so thrilled to share what I've been up to .here is some news:
[list]
[*] first free update patch for UNPLUGGED will be launch in a few days and it's gonna be fun (I promise :) ). I'll come back to this in further detail in a dedicated announcement.
[*] a free artbook of UNPLUGGED will be available for every owner of the game as a DLC in just a matter of days, check it out here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1749680/UNPLUGGED__artbook_Volume_I/]DLC[/url]
[*] last but not least, I have started my second game and I am very excited to show you the first glimpse of it in the upcoming weeks.
[/list]

To those of you who made it possible for me to come this far, players, friends, and supporters: From the bottom of my heart, Thank You. I really appreciate your support and I promise it won't be the last update but it's just the beginning and hopefully, I will be releasing even more regular updates from now on.

cheers,
omidjm
